messages:
alex: Heads-up — saw a console report where a customer admin could see another org's run list briefly. Not a full data dump but a stale sidebar entry. :eyes:

mira: ugh. any repro? which gateway?

alex: repro on prod via graphql gateway. Steps: quick org-switch in sidebar, then open recent runs. The runs list showed run IDs from prev org for ~2s then refreshed.

jun: Probable cache key bug. Are we caching GraphQL responses in the gateway or edge?

liam: Gateway cache yes — we have an edge-level response cache for admin queries. Key currently: ``cacheKey = route + queryHash + acceptLang``

sam: that misses org context. if org (workspace) is only in header, and we aren't including it, you can get cross-org hits during rapid switches.

alex: here's the log snippet from the gateway when I reproduced:
```
[1762254321] request GET /graphql - headers: {"x-org-id":"org-A","cookie":"..."}
[1762254322] cache HIT key=GET:/graphql:hash123
[1762254323] response served, cache_ttl=600ms
[1762254323] request GET /graphql - headers: {"x-org-id":"org-B","cookie":"..."}
[1762254324] cache HIT key=GET:/graphql:hash123
[1762254325] response served (stale org-A payload), cache_miss_on_client_refresh
```

mira: ouch. we need to include tenant in cache key. Also verify auth-layer isn't mutating x-org-id during request merge.

jun: Also a potential race: UI does an optimistic sidebar update before server confirms. That'll show stale rows until backend returns. But logs show gateway served cached payload for org-B request. so main issue is key.

liam: quick mitigation: add org id to cache key and reduce TTL to 250ms for admin routes until we finish verification.

sam: agree. Also add a guard: when serving cached response, validate response.ownerOrg == request.header.x-org-id, else bypass cache and increment metric tenant_mismatch_cache_hits.

ops-bot: deploy started: gateway/edge v2.14.3 -> canary (route: graphql-gateway-canary). CI id: #4821.

mira: can we also add telemetry? want to know how often this happens. metric: resolver.cache.tenant_mismatch_count, and a trace tag: tenant_mismatch=true

alex: good. also we should scan other caches (cdn, service-mesh sidecars). I found a similar pattern in internal api proxy last year.

jun: will grep infra for ``cacheKey *=`` and check other services. I'll post a short list in 15m.

liam: rolled canary patch with org in key and validation. monitoring: no mismatch spikes so far.

sam: prod rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m, rollback on >1 tenant_mismatch per minute or any 5xx increase.

alex: follow-up: add unit test ensuring cache key includes x-org-id and an e2e that does rapid org-switch in the console. Also add a short note to release notes + incident doc.

mira: tagging platform-security and support so they can triage any customer hits. @support FYI, might get a ticket.

sam: thanks all. nice catch alex. :thumbsup:

liam: FYI saved us from bigger exposure — patching now to other edge nodes.

ops-bot: deploy success: gateway/edge v2.14.3 -> canary complete. CI id: #4821.

alex: closing loop: prow job will backfill metrics for last 24h to see if we had any silent hits. I'll post results later.
